Subject: Recap: PoC success criteria & next steps

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we start the hands-on trial next week. I attached a working version of the success criteria workbook and a draft SOW (attachments below).

Summary of what we heard on the discovery call:
- Goal: Reduce clinical note turnaround time for inpatient discharges by surfacing summarizations and suggested ICD codes.
- Primary metric: median time-to-first-draft per discharge note (target: <= 10 minutes).
- Secondary metrics: suggestion acceptance rate (target >= 65%), hallucination incidence <= 1% on sampled vignettes.

Proposed PoC success criteria (see attached sheet for details):
1) Functional: Redwood model generates complete first drafts for >80% of sampled discharge notes.
2) Quality: Manual review (20 random samples/week) shows hallucination <=1% and clinically actionable suggestions >=65%.
3) Performance: End-to-end latency (secure VPC) median <= 800ms per API call under 10 TPS.
4) Security: Audit logs enabled, retention 90 days; no PHI persists outside customer VPC.

Ownership and immediate asks (please confirm owners or suggest changes):
- PoC technical lead (setup + infra): Sean Gallagher (redwood).
- Clinical quality & evals: Monica Patel (redwood) + Veridian clinical reviewer (Samantha).
- Legal / SOW redlines: Tom Becker (Veridian) and Marissa Cole (redwood).
- Exec readout: propose week of Jul 12 (internal exec slot) — need a 30–45 min slot for final go/no-go.

Timeline (high level):
- Week of Jun 21: environment build & onboarding (redwood + Veridian IT).
- Jun 28–Jul 9: run evaluation window, weekly sample reviews.
- Jul 12–16: exec readout & decision.

Next steps (please reply by EOD Mon Jun 22):
- Confirm owners above (Sean / Monica / Marissa) and Veridian reviewer.
- Confirm that the success metrics above reflect your priorities or suggest edits inline in the workbook.
- Confirm an exec readout week preference (we proposed Jul 12–16).

Attachments: PoC_Success_Criteria_v2.xlsx, Redwood_SOW_draft_v0.3.pdf

Thanks —
Nikhil
